description: Gets one Content Autopilot task with all its settings and schedule. Use when the user asks how a task is set up, before changing it, or why it made what it made. Not for run results (use list_autopilot_events). Returns the task's status, how it makes content, rules, schedule, clients and AI guidance.

task_id.description: ID of the autopilot task. Get it from list_autopilot_tasks.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: get_autopilot_task
title: Get content automation
